semiconductor_relevance: High — APP Systems Services Pte Ltd provides critical equipment and services related to plasma, vacuum technology, and thin films, which are essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: APP Systems Services Pte Ltd is a leading provider of sales and services for high technology products in the semiconductor industry, focusing on plasma, vacuum technology, and thin films. Established in 1982, the company supports critical processes in semiconductor manufacturing and adjacent industries with a comprehensive range of solutions and dedicated services.

regional_presence.Southeast Asia: APP has sales offices and service centers strategically located across all Southeast Asian countries.
regional_presence.India: The company also has a presence in India, enhancing its regional service capabilities.
